visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven final portable views against six individually viewed Qualla originals and the NPS architectural description. Paired water towers, four King Street miradors, open courtyard galleries, central solarium, dining oval and rear carriage bridges remain distinct. Review corrected obscured mirador openings, side-wall window contact, projecting timber balconies, rear openings and the central paired windows.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven final shared-material views including the footprint overlay. Wall, brick, tile, timber and metal use shared metric surfaces; glass remains local. Flat ground is a material fixture; portable views retain independent terrain.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen final lighting, quality and forced-detail views. Skyline preserves the U-shaped hotel, paired towers, miradors, dining oval and service range; district and street restore the major galleries, openings and roof elements. All four levels remain within hard budgets. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures; no physical-device performance measurement is claimed.

Anchor [-81.3148,29.89265], heading 0.285: +X east-northeast along King Street, +Z south-southeast toward the street. Independent unmodified Terrarium datum 1.7939 m uses the King Street approach [-1.3,53]; foundations extend to -2 m. Footprint suppression remains off.

fidelityReview.scope: Historic Ponce de Leon main hotel, dining oval and connected original service block; separate boiler/chimney, Artists Studios, later facilities and interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Six individually inspected Qualla originals, the NPS NHL architectural description, official Flagler tour descriptions and satellite roof context control the model. NPS 165-foot overall tower height governs the skyline; conflicting lower map height tags are retained as evidence. Other vertical dimensions, hidden elevations, roof joins and fine ornament remain interpretations. Dated photographs govern finishes; temporary restoration works, exact inscriptions and fine sculpture are excluded. No photo pixels copied.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels were visually inspected and pass budgets; exact triangle and byte counts are recorded in levels. Error values are authoring budgets, not measured deviations.
